parsed.post: Kept MATRIX_LR=0.04 + WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 (1.0375 -> 1.0312). This is a significant improvement! Following the monotone trend suggested by agent-9 and agent-5, I'll now probe a lower learning rate to see if we can achieve better convergence within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 to follow the observed trend that lower learning rates improve stability and convergence.
